market.question: Will Silver (SI) hit (LOW) $60 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Silver trading near $75.70 May 1 (May'26 futures) — would require ~21% drop to touch $60. Macro backdrop (Iran war, Hormuz closure, inflation worries) is bullish for precious metals; 8-week downside to $60 is a tail event with very low base-rate.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sudden ceasefire / dollar surge could compress metals but unlikely to retrace this much in 2 months
